$comment: What a release (a v… tag) uploads, with one line each for its notes (scripts/release-notes.mjs). {tag} is the release's tag. .github/workflows/release.yml uploads exactly these (src/test/docsync.test.ts checks it).

assets.name: splitscreenme-vscode-{tag}.vsix
assets.what: the VS Code extension: in VS Code run **Extensions: Install from VSIX…** (Ctrl+Shift+P)

assets.name: ncdev.exe
assets.what: `ncdev` for Windows, nothing else to install: the command line, the language server for other editors, and the Notepad++ setup (double-click it)

assets.name: ncdev-linux-x64
assets.what: `ncdev` for Linux (x64): `chmod +x` it and put it on your PATH as `ncdev`

assets.name: nucleus.js
assets.what: `ncdev` as one file for Node.js 18+, anywhere else (`node nucleus.js …`), also the MCP server for AI agents (`node nucleus.js mcp`)

assets.name: NcDev.zip
assets.what: the Notepad++ plugin on its own (64-bit), for Plugins Admin

assets.name: NcDev-x86.zip
assets.what: the Notepad++ plugin on its own (32-bit)

assets.name: workbench.html
assets.what: the whole browser workbench in one file: open it locally or host it yourself

assets.name: SHA256SUMS.txt
assets.what: checksums `ncdev update` checks the downloads against
